title: Kissed Crumbly Croatian Red Potatoes Pilaf
description: A funky and adventurous Croatian dish featuring red potatoes and lamination-puff, perfect for those looking for a gluten-free friendly meal option. This pilaf combines the natural sweetness of red potatoes with a crumbly texture from the lamination-puff.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced red potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamination-puff to the skillet, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks, and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Once the potatoes are done roasting, add them to the skillet with the lamination-puff mixture and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the pilaf cook, covered, for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the potatoes are coated in the crumbly lamination-puff mixture.
